run_jax_experiment: run a JAX experiment by passing a config file path via the --config flag
run_experiment_with_config: run the experiment entrypoint using an ml_collections config file to configure the experiment module
run_main_entrypoint: run the absl app entrypoint that loads a config and delegates to experiment.run_program
review_main_function: review the main function that validates CLI arguments and runs the experiment program
review_CONFIG_flag: review the _CONFIG flag definition that accepts a config file path for experiment configuration
